name: Hamster-kyou (Gurui) no Kare wa Nayande iru!!
original_name: ハムスター狂（ぐるい）の彼は悩んでいる！！
source:
Kimitaka is a young man who loves hamsters a little too much. 
No matter how much you try to get closer to him, his world only revolves around hamsters.
But as White Day approaches, he seems to be troubled about something.
Could it be love? Or is it still hamsters?
Colorful sweets, out-of-control creative hamsters, and an unstoppable love for hamsters.
The player watches over this hamster-obsessed man once again.
Will the unrequited love continue?!

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/hamnaya.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
公贵是一名对仓鼠爱得有些过头的青年。
无论你如何努力靠近他，他的整个世界依然只围着仓鼠打转。
然而随着白色情人节临近，他似乎正为某件事苦恼不已。
难道是为了恋爱？还是说依然和仓鼠有关？
五彩缤纷的甜点、彻底失控的创意仓鼠点心，以及一发不可收拾的仓鼠之爱。
玩家将再一次在旁守望这位痴迷仓鼠的男人。
这场单相思究竟还会继续下去吗？！

[译自[url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/hamnaya.html]官方网站[/url]]
